source_observations_unmeasured: The compositor loop is single-threaded: accept/dispatch, drain up to 64 HID records per kind, repaint only if dirty, flush clients, sleep 8 ms (main.rs:59-71). Drained input reaches clients only after that iteration's repaint.

A dirty repaint is a full-screen CPU pass with no damage tracking: a new 2560x1600 pixmap, background fill, layer and window draws (scene.rs:153+), a per-pixel conversion into a new ~16 MB buffer (pixels.rs:118-133), and a per-pixel volatile store to the WC framebuffer (presenter.rs:106-114). Every pointer event sets dirty (input.rs:100).

The observer keeps at most one frame in flight (released buffer plus no pending callback; protocol.rs:20-36). Each draw reallocates a full surface buffer and rerenders the whole grid (main.rs:715-742). Callbacks fire only after the compositor's present (server.rs:97-118).

Kernel queues are 64-slot rings that overwrite the oldest on overflow, with sequence numbers (PDHIDEventQueue.cpp:735-749). Relative motion arrives as raw report counts (integer path, exact via <<16 and >>16), and Chonkstep adds it 1:1 to screen pixels with no gain (input.rs:95-97). That may feel slow, which is separate from latency.
The text console path renders in-kernel and is not the compositor path.
